description: Extract representative restored and covered Royal Statue results and their direct Royal Reverence and Storage inputs

extractions.label: statue_bonus_0
extractions.description: Current Damage statue bonus at the saved level

extractions.label: statue_next_bonus_0
extractions.expression: (() => { const idleon = window.frames[0].idleon; const asNumber = window.frames[0].__idleon_cheats__["com.stencyl.behavior.Script"].asNumber; const index = 0; const level = asNumber(idleon.getAttr("RoyalG")[0][index]) + 1; const research = idleon.getAttr("CustomLists").h.Research; return (1 + idleon.callFunction("RoyalG", "ArmoryUpgBonus", 45, 0) / 100) * (asNumber(research[41][index]) + asNumber(research[42][index]) * Math.max(0, level - 1)); })()
extractions.description: Read-only Damage statue bonus at the saved level plus one; the game has no target-level preview API

extractions.label: statue_chance_0
extractions.description: Damage statue upgrade success chance as a fraction

extractions.label: statue_affordable_0
extractions.description: Numeric affordability result for one Damage statue parchment upgrade attempt

extractions.label: statue_bonus_2
extractions.description: Current Frosty statue bonus while covered

extractions.label: statue_next_bonus_2
extractions.expression: (() => { const idleon = window.frames[0].idleon; const asNumber = window.frames[0].__idleon_cheats__["com.stencyl.behavior.Script"].asNumber; const index = 2; const level = asNumber(idleon.getAttr("RoyalG")[0][index]) + 1; const research = idleon.getAttr("CustomLists").h.Research; return (1 + idleon.callFunction("RoyalG", "ArmoryUpgBonus", 45, 0) / 100) * (asNumber(research[41][index]) + asNumber(research[42][index]) * Math.max(0, level - 1)); })()
extractions.description: Read-only Frosty statue bonus at the saved level plus one; the game has no target-level preview API

extractions.expression: (() => { const idleon = window.frames[0].idleon; const asNumber = window.frames[0].__idleon_cheats__["com.stencyl.behavior.Script"].asNumber; const owned = idleon.getAttr("PixelHelperActor")[5].behaviors.getBehavior("ActorEvents_232")._ItemsAndStorageOWNED.h; return asNumber(owned["RGshard2"]); })()
extractions.description: Settled Storage marble quantity used by the Frosty statue restoration attempt
